title: Program wire — the toy witness's state (§10.6)
description: The toy's store: one keyed state channel, a member per key, members Ordinal like every object here. A toy scenario starts from the EMPTY state (`{}`); the state is observable in a trace only through the labels that read it, and this is its shape wherever a host writes it down. Keys under `sys.` are the host-reserved namespace: a document may carry one, and the fold refuses to WRITE one. A repeated key is refused rather than resolved by position, since two readers keeping different occurrences would hold different stores — a rule JSON Schema cannot state, so it is §10.6's.
